retentionRules.LOW confidence entries: Retain 14 days; never used for gates
retentionRules.SUPERSEDED entries: Retain as historical record; marked superseded
retentionRules.REJECTED entries: Retain with REJECTED flag; excluded from query defaults
retentionRules.STALE entries: Flagged; excluded from query unless explicitly requested

cleanupRules: Never delete HIGH entries without explicit user confirmation
SUPERSEDED entries retained for audit trail
REJECTED entries retained so rejection is not lost across sessions
No automatic deletion of any entry during live phase
